scripts.build:examples: echo Building example instances... && mkdir -p $PROJECT_CWD/app/public/instances && mkdir -p $PROJECT_CWD/app/public/templates/@pcms && cd $PROJECT_CWD/app/public/instances/ && zip -r my-contact-card.zip 6fa27a2f-2f1e-413d-a842-424242424242 && echo Done with example instances.
scripts.build: yarn build:examples && yarn workspaces foreach -Ap --include 'packages/*' run build && yarn workspaces foreach -Ap --include 'templates/*' run build && yarn workspace @pcms/app run build
scripts.typecheck: yarn workspaces foreach -Ap --include 'packages/*' run typecheck && yarn workspaces foreach -Ap --include 'templates/*' run typecheck && yarn workspace @pcms/app run typecheck
scripts.test: yarn workspaces foreach -Ap --include 'packages/*' run test && yarn workspaces foreach -Ap --include 'templates/*' run test && yarn workspace @pcms/app run test
